svg.text: Shallow Water Barge screens GO across 8in-24in at 7m-30m while Large PLV is draft-limited at the shallowest row.
Colour cue: green >=80% pass/utilisation margin OK; amber 50-79% or high utilisation risk; red <50%.
Large PLV | 24 GO / 30 cells | Depths: 10m-30m | Pipe sizes: 8in-24in; limiting: tension
Shallow Water Barge | 29 GO / 30 cells | Depths: 7m-30m | Pipe sizes: 8in-24in; limiting: overbend
Vessel parameters are representative classes only; not measured telemetry or exact specifications of any named vessel.
